samples.prompt: Communities should make everyday walking more convenient. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
requirementsVi: Nêu lập trường đồng ý.

samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that communities should make everyday walking more convenient raises a useful question about walking as a daily habit. I agree with this view because it can meet a practical need. My support does not mean that every version of the proposal will work; the way it is introduced is also important.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng ý rõ, không khẳng định mọi cách làm đều tốt.

parts.text: communities should make everyday walking more convenient raises a useful question about walking as a daily habit.
I agree with this view
parts.labelVi: Nêu lập trường đồng ý

parts.text: because it can meet a practical need. My support does not mean that every version of the proposal will work; the way it is introduced is also important.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — lợi ích
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. This is possible because a useful route to a shop or bus stop can make walking part of a journey rather than an extra task. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — cách làm khả thi
paragraphs.text: A second reason for supporting this approach is that its difficulties can be addressed through practical changes. A practical response would be to keep pavements clear and improve practical walking routes. For example, a local group could identify one important route to the market and report the barriers along it. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.

paragraphs.text:
It is true that an ambitious hobby plan can become another source of pressure, especially because expensive equipment and demanding goals may make a beginner feel unsuccessful. This calls for better planning rather than the complete rejection of the idea.

In conclusion, I support the view that people should protect some regular time for enjoyable hobbies. The main benefit is that a hobby can provide a break from work and routine responsibilities. However, careful planning and a response to practical difficulties are needed if that benefit is to be achieved.
